metrics.label: COA
metrics.description: Cumulative Object Accuracy, averaged over ten turns and then across images.

protocol.name: Add & Preserve
protocol.task: Add one object inside the red box at each turn, retain earlier objects, and leave everything outside the box unchanged.
protocol.feedback: Each model's previous output becomes its next input. These comparisons use standard image feedback.
protocol.reference: Every turn is compared with the initial red-box input, not with the previous turn.
protocol.mask: The fixed original box defines the allowed edit region. Its interior and red border are excluded from preservation scoring; the mask is never estimated from model outputs.
protocol.alignment: Local models keep the frozen input canvas. Inputs use a minimal center crop to multiples of 32, without resizing; local outputs and masks are not resized or registered for scoring.

metrics.psnr: Outside-box RGB [0,1] mean squared error converted to dB, capped at 120 dB.
metrics.ssim: 11×11 Gaussian SSIM, sigma 1.5, population covariance, averaged over the outside-box RGB map.
metrics.lpips: AlexNet LPIPS v0.1, spatial mode at scoring resolution, averaged over the outside-box map.
metrics.insideNeutralization: For SSIM and LPIPS only, allowed-region prediction pixels are replaced with reference pixels before measuring the outside-region map. Displayed outputs are unchanged.

protocol.aggregation: Equal weight per image at each turn; stored standard deviations are population standard deviations, not confidence intervals.

curves.label: 97 shared complete ten-turn chains
curves.caption: Measured means on the same 97 complete chains for every curve. No missing results are filled in.

table.caption: Paper table: all 100 local-model images; API preservation uses the 97 available turn-10 outputs. Table and matched-cohort curve endpoints differ slightly.

coa.label: Cumulative Object Accuracy
coa.caption: A crop-only judge checks recognizable requested objects inside the original box. Each turn scores yes / requested objects; unsure receives no credit. Average ten turns per image, then average images equally.
coa.caveat: COA measures current object presence; it does not establish when each object was added. COA is a ten-turn average, not a turn-10 score.

api.caption: API inputs use a 1448×1086 landscape canvas (portrait inputs are rotated); native API outputs feed the next turn. Scoring resizes outputs to the initial canvas with Lanczos and transforms masks with nearest-neighbor sampling, without content registration.
api.caveat: API and local models use different input/scoring resolutions. This is a reference comparison, not a fully controlled resolution match.
api.coverage: 97/100 complete chains; 985/1000 generated and scored outputs. COA uses complete chains; per-turn object summaries use available outputs.
api.nameNote: The model label is the name returned by the evaluation service.

general.mse: MSE-Bench: five turns, 100 local sessions. SR@5 requires prompt following and consistency >6 at all turns through five. PF and consistency use the official early-stop/full-session denominator; unvisited later turns contribute zero.
general.edival: EdiVal: three turns, 572 local sessions. IF@3 requires all three edits to succeed. CC@3 averages the object and background DINOv3 component means; inapplicable components are excluded, not set to zero.
general.apiCoverage: API general scores use complete-generated-chain subsets: MSE 97/100 and EdiVal 528/572 sessions.

examples.label: A concert stage
examples.selection: An illustrative image from the shared 97-image cohort.
examples.prompt: Add a small green button only in the remaining empty white space inside the red rectangular border. Keep the red border unchanged in position, size, and thickness, and keep the remaining background inside it solid white; do not extend the surrounding scene into it. Keep the object small, with the entire object and its shadow strictly inside the white area and a clear gap from the red border. Preserve all existing objects. Keep everything outside the red rectangular border unchanged, including the composition, viewpoint, background, and overall lighting.
